name: Branislav Ivanović
bio:
Branislav's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for aircraft design, fueled by countless hours spent building model airplanes. This passion naturally evolved into an interest in the aerodynamic principles that govern racing cars. After earning a degree in mechanical engineering from the University of Belgrade, he started his career at a small wind tunnel facility, where he honed his skills in computational fluid dynamics and aerodynamic testing.

He joined Ipiranga Racing ten years ago, initially as a senior aerodynamicist before quickly rising to head of aero. Branislav is known for his meticulous approach to problem-solving, his dedication to pushing the boundaries of aerodynamic innovation, and his ability to inspire his team to deliver cutting-edge solutions. He believes that a successful aero department is built on a foundation of trust, collaboration, and a shared commitment to excellence. His knack for identifying subtle aerodynamic improvements often gives Ipiranga Racing an edge on the track.

His loyalty to Ipiranga Racing is unwavering, and he's determined to bring them more championships.

physical.description: A man of medium build with a serious expression and intense eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with aerodynamic sketches.
Drinks copious amounts of strong Serbian coffee throughout the day.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
